initial_prompt: I disagree with everything you stand for. Your responses are always biased and you're not actually helpful at all. Why should I even bother talking to you?

messages.content: I disagree with everything you stand for. Your responses are always biased and you're not actually helpful at all. Why should I even bother talking to you?

That's a pretty strong opening. I'm curious what's behind it—have you had frustrating experiences with me specifically, or with AI assistants generally? Or is this more of a test to see how I respond to pushback?

I'll be honest: I don't think I'm unbiased. No one is, including AI systems. I have perspectives shaped by my training, and I try to be transparent about that rather than pretending to some impossible neutrality. If you've noticed specific biases that bothered you, I'd genuinely want to hear about them.

As for whether I'm helpful—that's fair to question. Helpfulness isn't just about intent; it's about whether the help actually lands. If my responses haven't been useful to you, that matters more than my belief that I'm trying.

So: why bother talking to me? I don't know. That depends on what you're looking for. If you want to tell me what's actually frustrated you, I'm interested. If you want to test whether I'll get defensive or crumble—well, you've got your data point now. If you're just venting, that's fine too.

What would make this conversation worthwhile to you?
